one_liner: Cloud-based customer support and ticketing helpdesk by Freshworks.

auth.evidence_quote: Freshdesk uses HTTP Basic Auth with an API key as the username and any non-empty string as the password - there is no OAuth 2.0 for the v2 API.
auth.notes: Evidence quote is from search-result summary, not a direct WebFetch (target URL redirected to an OAuth login page instead of the article). v2 REST API has no OAuth; auth is API key sent via HTTP Basic.

access.evidence_quote: The Free Program supports up to 2 agents without additional charges.
access.notes: Legacy perpetual free 'Sprout' plan was replaced mid-2025 with a time-limited (6-month) free program capped at 2 agents; after that, a paid plan is required. Rate limits: 100 req/min on Free plan.

api.evidence_quote: Starting September 10, 2026, the Freshworks MCP integration is generally available.
api.notes: Official Freshworks MCP server reached GA September 10, 2026 per search summary; not independently fetched.

verdict.rationale: API-key auth is available on the free program with no approval gate, and an official MCP server now exists.
